comparisons.editorial_decision: Retain witnessed awkward reading in the copy-text with sic apparatus note; do not emend without manuscript images.
Prefer I1876 الغائي as the edited reading: 'ultimate/purposive objective'; preserve B2007 الغائب in apparatus. Witnessed PRINT comparison only, not an independently attested manuscript variant.

Prefer I1876 علميا because directly read and supported by close context concerning العلم الذاتي والصفاتي; modern printed digital عمليّا is recorded, not silently changed; this is a PRINT-level correction, not manuscript evidence.
Corroborates the words omitted in older GNAMMA excerpt. Keep earlier correction and distinguish source transcription error from actual copy variation.

Adopt historic printed العمائية, the Cloud-like Presence, based on visually inspected I1876 printed p18 scan22; retain Beirut العملية in apparatus. Internal B2007 p36 also reads العمائية. Manuscript folios not checked.
Adopt historically attested masculine المذكور, agreeing with التعيّن; preserve feminine المذكورة of B2007 in apparatus. Subsequent coordination/syntax still requires manuscript scrutiny.
